title: Astro Portal API v1 — the sky solution of an image of a capture, and the annotations the portal draws from it
description: A typed object, never shown to a person: computed on the person's computer by Astro Sync (ASTAP by default, astrometry.net when chosen, or read without any computation from a header NINA or ASIAIR already solved), or carried over by an import. It belongs to **one image** of a capture — the main image or a variant — and to that image's bytes (its SHA-256): deleting the image deletes it. The portal draws the sky annotations alone from it, its target catalogue and the HYG stars. Conventions: pixels with `x` to the right and `y` downward, the image spanning `[0, width]` × `[0, height]`; the field centre is the image's centre; `rotationDeg` is the position angle of the image's up direction (towards row 0) from celestial north towards east, `0` being « north up »; `parity` is `normal` when east is to the left of north (as the sky is seen), `mirrored` when the image is flipped. Routes: `PUT /v1/captures/{id}/sky-solution` (a device token of the space; `put`), `GET` (a device token or the web session; `one`), `DELETE` (the owner's web session; `deleted`), `?imageId=` naming a variant (the main image otherwise); `GET /v1/captures?skySolution=missing` (the captures whose main image has none); `GET /v1/captures/{id}/original` (a device token of the space: the original to solve, `Range` honoured); `GET /v1/gallery/{id}/annotations[?imageId=][&magnitude=]` (`annotations`, open to anyone while the image is shown and the owner's switch on) `GET /v1/captures/{id}/sky-solution/annotations[?imageId=][&magnitude=]` (`annotations` again, for the owner's own capture: a device token or the web session, switch and visibility ignored) and, for a private gallery behind its gate, `GET /v1/portals/{token}/annotations/{id}[?imageId=][&magnitude=]` (the same answer); `POST|GET /v1/manage/captures/{id}/sky-solution/solve` (`solveState`, only where `sky.solve_on_server` is true, 404 otherwise). See api/v1.md, « Sky solutions ».

source.description: `header`: the WCS of a header already solved (NINA, ASIAIR), no computation; `astap`; `astrometry-net` (Astro Sync's optional solver, or a private server's fallback); `import`: carried over from the old portal.

solution.description: What a client sends (the `solution` of `put`). Every field but `solverVersion` is required; an unknown field is refused (`400 invalid_request`); `annotationsEnabled` is the owner's switch, never a device's field.

raDeg.description: Right ascension of the field centre, decimal degrees, J2000.

decDeg.description: Declination of the field centre, decimal degrees, J2000.

pixelScaleArcsec.description: Arc seconds per pixel of the solved image.

rotationDeg.description: Position angle of the image's up direction, from north towards east.

width.description: Pixels of the image solved. The service refuses a solution whose proportions differ from the stored image's by more than 1 % (`422 sky_solution_aspect_mismatch`): a reduced copy of the image is accepted, a cropped or turned one is not.

put.description: `PUT /v1/captures/{id}/sky-solution`, a device token of the capture's space only (a web session or no token: `401 device_authentication_required`). `sha256` is the digest of the image the solution was computed on (the main image or a variant): no image of the capture holding it is `409 image_changed`. Idempotent by digest: `201` a new solution; `200` the same one again (`changed: false`) or a replacement (`changed: true`).

stored.description: A solution as the owner and Astro Sync read it: its fields, the image it belongs to, and the owner's switch « Afficher le plate solving » (`annotationsEnabled`, one per capture, on by default; `PATCH /v1/manage/captures/{id}` `{ "skyAnnotations": boolean }`, refused `409 sky_solution_not_found` while no image of the capture has a solution).

deleted.description: The answer of `DELETE /v1/captures/{id}/sky-solution` (the owner's web session with its CSRF token).

public.description: The solution of the image shown, as a visitor's gallery reads it (`gallery.schema.json`, `skySolution` of a capture and of a public variant): present only while the image has a solution and the owner's switch is on, absent otherwise (the page is then the one of before). The sky only — no digest, no solver, no date — and where the annotations are.

annotations.description: `GET` it for the annotations of this image.

annotation.description: One annotation, in pixels of the copy the gallery serves (the list `PlateOverlay` reads): a catalogue object (`ngc`; `target: true` for a target of the capture, listed first; then the two largest other objects of the field), or a star (`bright`, brightest first; `names: []` is a point without a label).

names.description: The label of the star; empty for a point of the image (a star fainter than magnitude 8.5 known by a catalogue number only, or by none).

annotations.description: `GET /v1/gallery/{id}/annotations[?imageId=][&magnitude=]`: the annotations of the image a visitor sees, drawn by the portal alone (no `solve-field`, no `wcsinfo`), in the pixels of the copy the gallery serves (`image`). `magnitude` is the faintest star listed (10 by default; `99` asks for every star of the catalogue in the field): the stars come in batches by threshold (3.5, 5.5, 8.5, 10, all — at most 400, 800, 2000, 4000 and 10000 stars, brightest first), the viewer asks for the batch of its selector. `starsAvailable` is `false` when this server has no star catalogue (HYG): the annotations then hold the catalogue's objects only, whatever the magnitude. The gallery's one `404 capture_not_found` whenever the capture is not public, the image not shown, the image without a solution, or the switch off.

serverFeatures.description: What this server does by itself, read from its environment and outside the capability map (whose readers are strict). `sky.solve_on_server`: a private server whose operator installed astrometry.net solves an image on demand (`ASTRO_PORTAL_SKY_SOLVE_ON_SERVER=1` with `ASTRO_PORTAL_SOLVE_FIELD` and `ASTRO_PORTAL_ASTROMETRY_INDEX_DIR`). Carried by `GET /v1/manage/captures` and `GET /v1/manage/captures/{id}`.

solveState.description: `POST /v1/manage/captures/{id}/sky-solution/solve` (`202`, « Résoudre sur ce serveur ») and `GET` on the same path: where the resolution of an image on this server stands. `failed` carries its `reason`: `not_solved` (too few stars, a field outside the installed indices), `unreadable_solution`, `not_started` (the binary cannot be run), `image_changed`, `sky_solution_aspect_mismatch`.

refusal.description: 400 `invalid_request` (not `{ sha256, solution }`, a field out of its range, an unknown field); 401 `device_authentication_required` (`PUT`, the original: no device token), `authentication_required` (`DELETE`, the solve route: no web session); 403 `csrf_invalid`, `web_session_required` (`DELETE` or the solve route with a device bearer); 404 `capture_not_found` (another space's capture, or none), `image_not_found` (`?imageId=` of no image of the capture), `sky_solution_not_found`, `original_not_found`, `not_found` (the solve route where `sky.solve_on_server` is false); 409 `image_changed` (no image of the capture holds the digest: the capture changed since the solution was computed); 413 `payload_too_large`; 422 `sky_solution_aspect_mismatch`; 503 `capture_storage_unavailable`.
